items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: I'd be talking to Ernest Rogers or somebody like that, the drummer

ctx.x: Well, and sometimes even at Lutchen's I'd be talking to Ernest Rogers or somebody like that, the drummer, and one of the Lutchen brothers would give me a hard time. Hmm. Which is why I was always bothering the musicians. Of course they were rather pugnacious, both of the brothers having been boxers, I think. Oh.
Well, that's something I didn't know anything about. Yeah.
